title: [Main]-Issue in TDS calculation during payment application against invoices
summary: Fixed TDS calculation during payment application against invoices by scaling the applied amount to match the payment's TDS base, ensuring correct tax base computation when GST and payment amounts differ.
key_points: TDS advance payments now use scaled applied amount based on payment TDS base ratio instead of gross amount
Applied amount calculation: (Amount to Apply) × (Payment TDS Base ÷ Payment Amount)
Fixed issue where partial payments and multiple invoice applications caused incorrect TDS base and tax amounts
Scoped consumed original invoice amount to prevent cross-payment interference in multi-invoice scenarios
Updated use case configuration version to 36 for schema changes
quote: Applied amount ko payment ke TDS base terms me scale kiya, sirf apply hone wale payment se scoped
